name: Cinova
subtitle: AI Movie & TV Discovery
description:
Cinova is the AI-powered movie and TV show discovery app that learns what you love and surfaces hidden gems before everyone else knows about them.

Discover content with a TikTok-style vertical feed. Swipe through movies, save what you want to watch, and let our AI find your next obsession.

Features:
• AI-powered recommendations using your taste profile
• CinovaScore — proprietary quality rating that goes beyond star ratings
• TikTok-style Discover feed with full-screen trailers
• Natural language search: "dark thrillers like Parasite"
• Streaming availability for Netflix, Disney+, Apple TV+, and more
• Track your watchlist across all streaming services
• Anonymous-first: use without signing up

From the makers of OpenOva — technology that actually works for you.
